parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: Department
parameters.description: The department name. Matches any level of the organizational structure to which the user belongs. Specify the department name itself without the full path of the organizational structure. The value can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), commas (,), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

parameters.name: DevTag
parameters.description:
The unique identifier of the user terminal device. Exact match. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Lists user terminal devices.

parameters.name: DevType
parameters.description:
The operating system type of the user terminal device. Valid values:
- **windows**: Windows.
- **macOS**: macOS.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time for filtering by virus file discovery time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter must be specified together with StartTime and must be later than StartTime.

parameters.name: FileMd5
parameters.description: The MD5 value of the virus file. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: FileProcessStatus
parameters.description:
Filters by disposition status. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by disposition status is applied. Valid values:
- **Pending**: Pending disposition.
- **Processed**: Disposed.

parameters.name: Hostname
parameters.description: The hostname of the user terminal device. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: Operations
parameters.description: Filters by disposition action. Duplicate values are not allowed. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by disposition action is applied.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: RiskLevels
parameters.description: Filters by risk level. Duplicate values are not allowed. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by risk level is applied.

parameters.name: SaseUserId
parameters.description:
The user ID. Exact match. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Lists user terminal devices.
- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries user terminal device details.

parameters.name: ScanTaskId
parameters.description:
The ID of the virus scan task that detected the virus file. This parameter is used to filter detection results of a specified task. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
- [ListVirusScanTasks](~~ListVirusScanTasks~~): Lists virus scan tasks.
- [CreateVirusScanTask](~~CreateVirusScanTask~~): Creates a virus scan task.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time for filtering by virus file discovery time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter must be specified together with EndTime and must be earlier than EndTime.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), asterisks (*), hyphens (-), at signs (@), spaces, middle dots (·), and parentheses.

parameters.name: VirusTypes
parameters.description: Filters by virus type. Duplicate values are not allowed. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by virus type is applied.
